description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410001 (23/1103)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and registration particulars. The content falls under the "PART III - LANDS" section and focuses on land registration and title settlement, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters.
